title: TapTools: Develop Mobile App for Android and iOS

ms.promise: Complete and finalize all UI/UX designs for every screen and feature of the TapTools app, ensuring designs are responsive across multiple device types and orientations.
ms.criteria: Designs must adhere to the latest web and mobile usability standards, ensuring they are intuitive and accessible.
ms.report:
We have completed and finalized the UI/UX designs for the TapTools mobile app. These designs ensure responsiveness across various device types and orientations, providing an intuitive and accessible experience for users. Although the submission includes mockups primarily for one iPhone screen size as a reference, the UI is fully optimized for a wide range of screen sizes and devices.
Access the design folder here: Google Drive Link

ms.promise:
・Integration of the approved UI/UX designs into the actual front-end codebase of the TapTools app, using frameworks and technologies specified in the project requirements.
・Development and implementation of the price alerts feature, which includes configuring and testing real-time notifications based on user-defined criteria.
ms.criteria:
・The front-end application must be fully responsive and functional, reflecting the UI/UX designs.
・The price alerts feature must accurately notify users of price changes, as per the defined alert settings.
ms.report:
Evidence for the Front-end Development and Feature Integration milestone. The submission includes:
・A video showcasing the functionality and user interactions of the mobile app on TestFlight. This demonstrates the app’s responsiveness and the implementation of the price alerts feature.
・Screenshots highlighting the accuracy and functionality of the price alerts system in notifying users of price changes based on their settings.

Due to the current TestFlight stage, the video captures only the mobile app’s default orientation. Once we move to the feedback stage in Milestone 4, we will incorporate additional evidence, including responsiveness across multiple devices and orientations, to provide a demonstration of the feature’s adaptability.
You can access the submitted evidence via this Google Drive link.

ms.promise:
Preparations for Submission:
・Complete a list of preparation tasks including compliance checks, legal reviews, and user testing.
・Ensure all app store guidelines and regulatory requirements are met.

Submit for Approval:
・Submit the TapTools app to both the Android Google Play Store and Apple App Store, meeting all guidelines.

Compliance Checklist:
・Google Play Store:
・Adhere to Google Play policies
・Verify permissions and data handling
・Apple App Store:
・Adhere to Apple’s App Store Review Guidelines
・Verify functionality and data protection
ms.criteria:
Automated and Manual Reviews:
・The app must pass all automated checks and manual reviews by the store reviewers.

Compliance Verification:
・Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and platform guidelines for both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
・Provide a report listing compliance metrics and regulatory requirements met during the preparation stage.
ms.report:
We are officially approved and all set up on Apple Developer Console and the Google Play Console.
View the evidence of milestone completion here: Google Drive Link

ms.promise:
Beta Release:
・Official release of the beta version of the TapTools app to a select group of users for real-world testing.
・Submit document of the criteria and process for selecting beta testers to ensure a diverse and effective testing group.

User Feedback Analysis:
・Collect and analyze user feedback to identify bugs, usability issues, and potential enhancements.
・Allocate time to address major issues identified during beta testing before the final release.
ms.criteria:
Stability and Bug Classification:
・The beta app must be stable, with no critical bugs that impact basic functionality.
・Critical bugs are defined as issues causing crashes or preventing core features from functioning.
・Stability metrics include crash rates, performance issues, and user-reported problems.

Comprehensive Feedback Report:
・Compile a detailed report of user feedback, identifying bugs, usability issues, and potential enhancements.
・Prioritize improvements based on severity, frequency, impact, and feasibility.
